text: Natural Language Processing, or NLP, is a field of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand human language. It allows machines to read and interpret text, which is called text understanding. NLP is also used in translation, so people can communicate across different languages more easily. Another important use is sentiment analysis, where computers identify whether a piece of writing is positive, negative, or neutral. This is useful for companies that want to know how customers feel about their products. Finally, NLP powers chatbots, which are programs that can answer questions and have simple conversations with users. Thanks to NLP, computers are becoming better at communicating with people every day.
